A thoughtful plan gives you room to enjoy the day. Here is how we work, before, during, and after your wedding.

A FEW GOOD THINGS TO KNOW

Comfort comes
from clarity.

These are the studio’s published booking and working policies. Your event proposal sets out the agreed scope.

Back to the collections ↗

When should we get in touch?

We recommend booking 9–12 months before your wedding.

How do we reserve our date?

A 30% non-refundable retainer reserves your date. The remaining balance is due 30 days before the event.

When do you arrive?

We arrive 45 minutes before your booked coverage begins, so we can get settled and check the light.

When will we see our photographs?

Sneak peeks arrive within 72 hours. Your full gallery is delivered within eight weeks of the wedding.

What if we need to cancel?

The retainer is non-refundable. If you cancel within 30 days of the event, the full balance is due.

Can we move our date?

One date change within 12 months is permitted, subject to availability.

How do you prepare for the unexpected?

Each photographer carries two camera bodies and records to dual memory cards. A backup associate is available for emergencies.

Will we spend the day posing?

We lightly direct portraits, then use candid documentary coverage for the rest of the day.

What does your editing include?

Our editing uses warm, true-to-life color and basic blemish retouching. We do not reshape bodies or create major composites.

Can we print and share our images?

Couples receive personal printing and sharing rights. Commercial use requires separate permission.

Do you deliver RAW files?

RAW files are not delivered. They are retained for 90 days after gallery delivery.

How long is our gallery online?

Your online gallery remains accessible for 12 months.

How does an album come together?

Album design includes two rounds of revisions. Your album ships within six weeks of design approval.

When do you need our photograph lists?

Please send your family-photo list and must-have photographs 14 days before the wedding.

Who will photograph our wedding?

Your team includes a lead photographer and a second photographer. If the lead is unavailable in an emergency, we arrange an associate replacement.
